reason: This text fragment (1 Chronicles 11:1-47) describes the gathering of all Israel to David at Hebron, his anointing as king, and the exploits of his mighty men. The passage explicitly depicts Yahweh's affirmation and support of David and Israel ('Yahweh your God said to you, You shall shepherd my people Israel'). There is no content expressing that Yahweh doesn't owe loyalty to the people, nor any consideration of replacing them with another people. The passage emphasizes covenant establishment and divine support, not disloyalty or abandonment.
